blocks.text: Majhul nisbat: is done, was done

Gapda harakatni kim bajarganini aytsak — bu **faol nisbat** (active): «Ishchilar ko'prikni qurdi» — Workers **built** the bridge. Agar bizni bajaruvchi emas, harakat nimaga qaratilgani qiziqtirsa, **majhul nisbat** (passive) ishlatiladi: «Ko'prik **qurildi**» — The bridge **was built**. O'zbek tilida majhul nisbat fe'lga `-il-` / `-in-` qo'shib yasaladi: qur → **quril**, yoz → **yozil**, tozala → **tozalan**. Ingliz tilida qo'shimcha yo'q — uning o'rniga ikki so'z olinadi: **be** fe'li + fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3).

E'tibor bering: faol gapdagi **to'ldiruvchi** (this bridge, the office) majhul gapda **ega** bo'lib, gap boshiga chiqadi. Bajaruvchi (workers, someone) esa yo tushib qoladi, yo gap oxirida **by** bilan keladi. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Ko'prikni qurdi» → «Ko'prik qurildi».

Majhul gapda vazifa ikkiga bo'linadi: **be** zamon va egani ko'rsatadi, **V3** esa harakatning o'zini. Hozirgi zamonda — **am / is / are** + V3 (is made, are sold), o'tgan zamonda — **was / were** + V3 (was built, were invited). **be** yangi egaga moslashadi: bitta narsa — is / was, ko'p narsa — are / were. To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 `-ed` bilan tugaydi (cleaned, opened, invited), noto'g'ri fe'llarda o'z shakli bor (made, built, written, stolen). V3 bilan Present Perfect'da tanishgansiz (→ 15-dars); fe'l shakllari — 24-darsda.

Majhul nisbatda yordamchi fe'l — **be**, shuning uchun inkor va so'roq gaplar oddiy am / is / are / was / were gaplari kabi quriladi (→ 1, 2 va 10-darslar). Inkorda be'dan keyin **not**: isn't made, wasn't invited. So'roqda be egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Is** it **made** ...? **Were** you **invited**? do / does / did bu yerda **ishlatilmaydi**: «Did the bridge built?» emas, **Was** the bridge **built**?

items.translation: Bu parkka it bilan kirishga **ruxsat berilmaydi**.

items.text: **Were** you **told** about the meeting? — No, I wasn't.

blocks.text: Majhul nisbat «chiroyli» bo'lishi uchun emas, ma'lum sababga ko'ra ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada ham «Xat yuborildi», «Ish tugatildi» deganda kim qilgani muhim emas. Ingliz tilida esa majhul nisbat o'zbekchadan ham ko'proq uchraydi — ayniqsa yangiliklarda, tarixda, e'lon va ko'rsatmalarda. Asosiy holatlar:

items: **bajaruvchi noma'lum**: My car **was damaged** last night. — kim urib ketgani noma'lum;
**bajaruvchi muhim emas yoki tushunarli**: Letters **are delivered** in the morning. — albatta, pochtachi;
**diqqat narsa yoki natijada**: The museum **was opened** in 1970. — gap muzey haqida, quruvchilar haqida emas.

items.text: Our car **was damaged** in the storm.

blocks.text: Bajaruvchi muhim yoki yangi ma'lumot bo'lsa, u **by** bilan qo'shiladi: The novel **was written by** Abdulla Qodiriy. O'zbekchada bunga «... tomonidan» to'g'ri keladi, lekin og'zaki nutqda ko'pincha faol gap ishlatiladi: «Romanni Abdulla Qodiriy yozgan». Tarjimada ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. Esda tuting: majhul gaplarning ko'pchiligida by **bo'lmaydi** — «by someone», «by people» deyilmaydi, chunki ular hech qanday ma'lumot bermaydi.

items.text: This novel **was written by** Abdulla Qodiriy.
The photos **were taken by** my brother.
Who **was** this picture **painted by**? — By a local artist.

blocks.text: «Tug'ilmoq» ingliz tilida ham majhul shaklda aytiladi: **be born**. Odam bir marta tug'iladi, shuning uchun deyarli doim o'tgan zamon: I **was born** in 2001, they **were born** in Bukhara. O'zbekchada bu fe'l ham `-il-` bilan (tug'**il**moq), lekin o'zbek o'quvchilari ko'pincha **was** ni tushirib qoldiradi. Savol: Where **were** you **born**? When **was** your father **born**?

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The bridge built in 1965.» → **The bridge was built in 1965.** (be tushib qolmaydi); «I born in Tashkent.» → **I was born in Tashkent.**; «The letter was write.» → **was written** (V1 emas, V3); «Did the car repaired?» → **Was the car repaired?** (do / did emas, be); «Cars are making in Korea.» → **Cars are made in Korea.** (`-ing` emas, V3 — mashina o'zi hech narsa yasamaydi).

Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha fe'lda `-il-` / `-in-` ko'rsangiz (yozildi, sotiladi, tozalandi) — inglizchada **be + V3**. Zamonni faqat **be** ko'rsatadi: is / are — hozir yoki doim, was / were — o'tmishda. V3 esa hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.
Majhul nisbatning boshqa shakllari — is **being** done (hozir jarayonda) va has **been** done (natija hozir) — 22-darsda. Barcha zamonlarda faol va majhul nisbat jadvali — 116-darsda.

examples.title: **is / are** + V3: how things are done
examples.description: Hozirgi zamon majhul nisbati: **am / is / are** + V3. Doimiy yoki odatiy harakat, kim bajarishi muhim emas: «yopiladi», «sotiladi», «tozalanadi».

sentences.text: Fresh bread **is baked** here every morning.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda har kuni ertalab yangi non **yopiladi**.

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan, plov **is cooked** for weddings and big holidays.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda to'y va katta bayramlarda palov **damlanadi**.

sentences.text: These phones **are made** in South Korea.
Our rubbish **is collected** on Tuesdays and Fridays.
sentences.translation: Chiqindilarimiz seshanba va juma kunlari **olib ketiladi**.

sentences.text: Breakfast **is served** from seven to ten in the hotel restaurant.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona restoranida nonushta soat yettidan o'ngacha **beriladi**.

sentences.text: At our school, exam results **are sent** to parents by email.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizda imtihon natijalari ota-onalarga elektron pochta orqali **yuboriladi**.

sentences.text: **I'm** often **asked** about my name because it's unusual.
sentences.translation: Ismim haqida mendan tez-tez **so'rashadi**, chunki u g'ayrioddiy.

sentences.text: Every year thousands of trees **are planted** along the roads.
sentences.translation: Har yili yo'llar bo'ylab minglab daraxtlar **ekiladi**.

sentences.text: In the south of the country, cotton **is grown** on large farms.
Most of our vegetables **are bought** at the local market, not in the supermarket.
sentences.translation: Sabzavotlarimizning ko'pi supermarketdan emas, mahalliy bozordan **sotib olinadi**.

examples.title: **was / were** + V3: what happened
examples.description: O'tgan zamon majhul nisbati: **was / were** + V3. O'tmishda nima bo'lgani muhim, kim qilgani emas: «qurilgan», «bekor qilindi», «ta'mirlandi».

sentences.text: My bike **was stolen** from outside the library.
The old cinema **was closed** in 2015.
Two hundred guests **were invited** to the wedding.
Yesterday all the flights from London **were cancelled** because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Kecha qor sababli Londondan barcha reyslar **bekor qilindi**.

sentences.text: This mosque **was built** more than five hundred years ago.
sentences.translation: Bu masjid besh yuz yildan ko'proq oldin **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: The windows **were washed** and the floor **was cleaned** before the guests arrived.
Luckily, nobody **was hurt** in the accident.
Our car **was repaired** in two days, and it was very cheap.
sentences.translation: Mashinamiz ikki kunda **ta'mirlandi**, ustiga juda arzonga tushdi.

sentences.text: Last week Bekzod **was offered** a job at a bank in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Bekzodga Toshkentdagi bankdan ish **taklif qilindi**.

sentences.text: Last spring new paths **were made** in the park, and hundreds of roses **were planted**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahorda parkda yangi yo'laklar **qurildi** va yuzlab atirgullar **ekildi**.

examples.title: Negative: **isn't / wasn't** + V3
examples.description: Inkor — **be** dan keyin **not**: isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't + V3. O'zbekchada: «-ilmaydi», «-ilmadi».

sentences.text: Smoking **isn't allowed** anywhere in the building.
sentences.translation: Binoning hech bir joyida chekishga **ruxsat berilmaydi**.

sentences.text: The rooms **aren't cleaned** on Sundays.
Sorry, credit cards **aren't accepted** here — cash only.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu yerda kredit kartalar **qabul qilinmaydi** — faqat naqd pul.

sentences.text: I **wasn't invited** to Emma's birthday party.
sentences.translation: Meni Emmaning tug'ilgan kun ziyofatiga **taklif qilishmadi**.

sentences.text: The letter **wasn't sent** because the address was wrong.
Those houses **weren't built** for big families.
Don't worry, the money **wasn't lost** — it was in your other bag.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, pul **yo'qolmagan** — u boshqa sumkangizda edi.

sentences.text: In our village the roads **aren't cleared** in winter, so the children walk to school through the snow.
sentences.translation: Qishloqimizda qishda yo'llar **tozalanmaydi**, shuning uchun bolalar maktabga qor kechib boradi.

sentences.text: My question **wasn't answered**, so I wrote to the manager again.
sentences.translation: Savolimga **javob berilmadi**, shuning uchun menejerga yana yozdim.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the mistakes in the report **weren't noticed** before the meeting.

examples.title: Questions: **Is it made** ...? **When was it built**?
examples.description: So'roq gapda **be** egadan oldin keladi: **Is** it **made** ...? **Were** you **invited**? So'roq so'z bilan: Where **are** they **made**? Qisqa javob — be bilan: Yes, it is. / No, I wasn't.

sentences.text: **Is** breakfast **included** in the price? — Yes, it is.
**Were** you **invited** to Aziz's wedding? — No, I wasn't.
sentences.translation: Sizni Azizning to'yiga **taklif qilishganmi**? — Yo'q, taklif qilishmagan.

sentences.text: Where **are** these beautiful carpets **made**?
When **was** this bridge **built**? — In 1972, I think.
**Was** anyone **hurt** in the fire? — No, luckily everyone was outside.
sentences.translation: Yong'inda kimdir **jabrlandimi**? — Yo'q, baxtga hamma tashqarida ekan.

sentences.text: How **is** the word "neighbour" **spelt** in British English?
What **is** this dish **called** in Uzbek?
**Are** the tickets **sold** online, or only at the station?
Why **was** the meeting **cancelled** yesterday? — Because the director was ill.
sentences.translation: Kechagi majlis nega **bekor qilindi**? — Chunki direktor kasal edi.

sentences.text: How many new jobs **were created** in the city last year?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili shaharda nechta yangi ish o'rni **yaratildi**?

examples.title: **by** + the doer: who did it?
examples.description: Bajaruvchi muhim yoki yangi ma'lumot bo'lsa — **by** bilan: written **by** ..., painted **by** .... O'zbekchada: «... tomonidan» yoki oddiy faol gap («akam olgan»).

sentences.text: This song **was written by** a young singer from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq buxorolik yosh xonanda **tomonidan yozilgan**.

sentences.text: The children **are taken** to school **by** their grandfather.
The new airport **was designed by** a British company.
sentences.translation: Yangi aeroport loyihasi Britaniya kompaniyasi **tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan**.

sentences.text: Most of the cooking at home **is done by** my father.
**Was** this photo **taken by** your sister? It's beautiful!
Our village school **was opened by** the mayor in 1996.
In the story, the king **is helped by** a poor farmer.
sentences.translation: Ertakda podshohga **bir kambag'al dehqon yordam beradi**.

sentences.text: The thief **was caught by** two police officers near the market.
Many of the films at the festival **were made by** students.
Who **was** this house **built by**? — By my great-grandfather.

examples.title: **was born** / **were born**
examples.description: «Tug'ilmoq» inglizchada doim majhul: I **was born** ... («I born» emas). Savol: Where **were** you **born**? When **was** she **born**?

sentences.text: I **was born** in Namangan in 1999.
Where **were** you **born**? — In a small town near Leeds.
sentences.translation: Siz qayerda **tug'ilgansiz**? — Lids yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada.

sentences.text: My grandmother **was born** in a village without electricity.
When **was** your daughter **born**? — Last March.
The twins **were born** on the same day as their grandfather.
Emma **wasn't born** in England — her family moved there from Canada.
sentences.translation: Emma Angliyada **tug'ilmagan** — oilasi u yerga Kanadadan ko'chib kelgan.

sentences.text: Our first son **was born** while we were living in Manchester.
**Were** both of your parents **born** in Tashkent?
Ten puppies **were born** at the farm last night.
Alisher Navoi **was born** in Herat in 1441.

examples.title: Active or passive? The same fact, two ways
examples.description: Bir voqea ikki xil: faol nisbatda kim qilgani muhim (Mum **makes** the bread), majhul nisbatda — nima bo'lgani (The bread **is made**). Faol gapdagi to'ldiruvchi majhul gapda egaga aylanadi.

sentences.text: My mother **makes** this bread every Friday.
sentences.translation: Bu nonni har juma kuni **onam yopadi**.

sentences.text: On Fridays this bread **is made** in a clay oven.
Somebody **left** a black bag on the bus.
A black bag **was left** on the number 12 bus this morning.
The police **arrested** two men after the football match.
sentences.translation: Futbol o'yinidan keyin politsiya ikki kishini **hibsga oldi**.

sentences.text: Two men **were arrested** after the match.
In Khorezm, farmers **grow** rice near the river.
In Khorezm, rice **is grown** near the Amu Darya.
Our teacher **checks** the homework on Mondays.
The homework **is checked** on Mondays, so do it at the weekend!
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasi dushanba kunlari **tekshiriladi**, shuning uchun uni dam olish kunlari bajaring!

examples.title: Mixed practice: news and history
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozirgi va o'tgan zamon majhul nisbati, inkor, savol va **by** — yangiliklar va tarix tilida.

sentences.text: Samarkand **was founded** more than 2,500 years ago.
Today the Registan **is visited** by thousands of tourists every week.
sentences.translation: Bugun Registonga har hafta minglab sayyohlar **tashrif buyuradi**.

sentences.text: A new metro line **was opened** in Tashkent last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Toshkentda yangi metro liniyasi **ochildi**.

sentences.text: **Are** photos **allowed** inside the museum? — Yes, but without flash.
sentences.translation: Muzey ichida suratga olishga **ruxsat berilganmi**? — Ha, lekin chaqnoqsiz.

sentences.text: Three paintings **were stolen** from a gallery in London on Saturday night.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni kechasi Londondagi galereyadan uchta rasm **o'g'irlandi**.

sentences.text: The thieves **weren't seen** by the guards, but their car **was found** the next morning.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilarni qorovullar **ko'rmagan**, lekin ertasi kuni ertalab ularning mashinasi **topildi**.

sentences.text: Every year the city **is cleaned** and **decorated** before Navruz.
sentences.translation: Har yili Navro'z oldidan shahar **tozalanadi** va **bezatiladi**.

sentences.text: Many old buildings in the centre **were knocked down** in the 1970s.
Why **was** the road **closed** this morning? — Because of an accident.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab yo'l nega **yopildi**? — Avariya sababli.

sentences.text: At Chorsu Bazaar, spices and dried fruit **are sold** from early morning.
sentences.translation: Chorsu bozorida ziravorlar va quritilgan mevalar erta tongdan **sotiladi**.
